capabilities: Fetch attended concerts from the setlist.fm API
Write concerts to a Setlist Concerts Attended.md file as a bulleted list
Add date-specific backlinks for each concert
Add a backlink for the concert's city
extras: Users must supply their own setlist.fm API key; the README invites feedback and contributions, suggesting an early-stage project.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull your concert history from setlist.fm into your notes.

relations.evidence: This project uses the setlist.fm API to sync the concerts you've attended

summary: Setlist.fm integration that syncs concerts you have attended into a vault note with date-specific and city backlinks.
